description: This plot illustrates the loss of two models, Vanilla and SepLLM, over training time. The x-axis is labeled "Training Time (s)" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250000 seconds, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 50000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and features a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.05. The plot displays two solid data lines. The "Vanilla" line is purple with downward-pointing triangle markers; it begins at a loss of approximately 2.75 at 0 seconds, exhibits a steep decline to roughly 2.60 at 50000 seconds, and then follows a more gradual downward trend, ending at approximately 2.55 at 250000 seconds. The "SepLLM" line is red with square markers; it starts at approximately 2.75 at 0 seconds, declines steeply to about 2.58 at 50000 seconds, and continues to decrease gradually, reaching approximately 2.50 at 250000 seconds. Additionally, a vertical green dashed line segment with a downward-pointing arrow and the label "1.26x" is positioned near the 250000-second mark, spanning the vertical gap between the two data lines.
